up: Retrieve activity records with standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM' for the human SRC kinase target (CHEMBL267). Return the following columns for each matching activity: standard_value (IC50), compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, and target_information. Do not apply row limits.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_information FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL267' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
